_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: no single breaker (extremes cancel) justifies leaving the Denial band until range or F&G breaks.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst HOLD/CAUTION in Denial; narrative implies constructive accumulation bias without an explicit phase/direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 32-42 and BTC stays inside recent range without volume expansion
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks under 25, or a >2.3% daily close with ETF flows and CVD confirming the same direction
